**NORTHBANK COMMUNITY GARDEN**
**Notice to All Members and Visitors**

**North Gate Closure: Saturday 18 April**

Please note that the north gate will be closed on **Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm** while we repair a leaking water pipe. The leak has been wasting water and softening the path beside the herb beds, so we want to fix it quickly and properly.

**Please use the east entrance** during the closure. It will be open as usual, and signs will direct you from the street. Please take care on the temporary path, which may be uneven in places.

**Seed swap moved to Sunday**

Because of the repair work, this month's seed swap will now take place on **Sunday 19 April at 11 am**. Bring any spare seeds, cuttings, or seedlings to share, and feel free to bring labels and pens to help others identify what they take home.

**Volunteers needed**

We would be grateful for extra hands on Saturday to help clear the work area, move materials, and tidy up afterward. Please **bring gloves**; all tools will be supplied.

Our resident volunteer coordinator, **Mina**, will organize the helpers and assign tasks. Speak with her at the east entrance when you arrive.

Thank you for your patience and for helping keep Northbank thriving.

*The Northbank Garden Committee*

**Heads up, Northbankers: the north gate's closed Saturday**

So the water pipe by the north gate has been weeping for weeks now, and it's finally time to fix it before it turns into a proper swamp (the slugs are thrilled, but the rest of us aren't). On **Saturday 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm**, the north gate will be closed while repairs happen.

Don't worry, you can still get in. Just use the **east entrance**, the one by the compost bins. It's a slightly longer walk from the bus stop, but the lilacs along that path are worth it right now.

Because the digging will be noisy and muddy, we're moving the **seed swap to Sunday at 11 am**. Bring your saved seeds, your half-used packets, and that mystery squash you swore you'd label last autumn. We'll sort it out together.

Want to help with the repair day? We'd love the hands. **Bring gloves**; tools are supplied, so leave your good trowel at home. Mina coordinates our volunteers, so find her at the east entrance or catch her in the garden shed if you're not sure where to start.

See you in the mud.

*The Northbank Community Garden crew*

**Northbank Community Garden: North Gate Closure on Saturday 18 April**

The north gate will be closed this Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm. A water pipe beneath the gate path has been leaking for several weeks, and the repair needs the whole stretch of path dug up. Please don't try to squeeze past the work area. The ground will be open and uneven.

Use the east entrance during the closure. It is the gate beside the compost bins, and it will stay unlocked for the full five hours. The route to the main beds is slightly longer from that side, so allow a few extra minutes if you are coming to water.

**Seed swap moved to Sunday**

Because of the repair, the seed swap will not take place on Saturday. It is now on Sunday 19 April at 11 am. The north gate will be open again by then, and the tables will be set up in the usual spot near the shed.

**Volunteers needed**

We could use extra hands on Saturday to clear the soon-to-be-disturbed edges of the path and move pots out of the way. Please bring your own gloves. Tools are supplied.

Mina, one of our residents, is coordinating volunteers. Tell her you are coming, or find her at the east entrance on Saturday morning.

Thank you for your patience while the pipe is fixed.

**NORTHBANK COMMUNITY GARDEN**

**North gate closed Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm**

A leaking water pipe by the north gate needs repairing, so the gate will be shut from **9 am to 2 pm on Saturday 18 April**. The garden stays open. Come in through the **east entrance** instead.

**Seed swap moves to Sunday**

This month's seed swap will now be held on Sunday 19 April at 11 am, rather than on Saturday. Bring whatever seeds you have to share, and come along even if you have none to swap.

**Volunteers**

If you can spare some time on Saturday while the repair is under way, we would like to hear from you. Bring a pair of gloves. Tools are supplied, so there is no need to carry your own.

Mina, a Northbank resident, is coordinating volunteers. Tell her you are coming, and she will let you know how you can help.

If your plot is near the north gate, please plan your Saturday visit around the closure and enter by the east side.

Thanks, and see you on Sunday for the swap.

The Northbank Garden Committee
